{{Top|leg}}
The '''Arboretum''' was a botanical collection pertaining to trees. Various recreational areas such as [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and Space stations featured such [[Plant/Legends|plant]] life. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] ''[[Empire Forever]]'' was one of such ships.
